details:
Description

With the new UI is not possible to create Group+ unlocked portals. The feature was present before the new UI and its removal was not mentioned in any changelog so I guess is an unwanted behavior.

The lack of the feature make it hard for some community I'm a moderator for to properly conduct their events.

Reproduction Steps

1. Open VRChat

2. Get into any public instance

3. Drop a Group+ portal

4. Anybody not in your friend list or not in the group will not see the portal.

No workarounds found, unless you open a Group Public wich is something we don't want to do.

With the old UI the feature was present and everybody was able to see the Group+ portal.

Details

- Category: User Interface

- Frequency: Always
